description: BLOCKING watcher review of b651ed9 (li-6b6u6m) found two bypasses of NFR §"Local memory guardrails": (1) scripts/check-memory.ts treats ANY substring occurrence of an .ai/*.md path in AGENTS.md as indexing (agentsIndex.includes(path)), so a stray prose mention outside the Agent-facing notes index lets an unindexed note commit; the spec requires every note to be referenced from the AGENTS.md INDEX with its purpose. description: BLOCKING watcher review of 3a21662 (li-oaxjqm) found two bypasses of NFR §"Result and railway-oriented programming discipline" in scripts/check-result.ts: (1) the ignored-Result check only inspects bare expression statements, so assigning a Result-typed call to a never-read variable (const _ignored = parse(...)) discards the Result undetected — the spec requires no ignored Result/AsyncResult return values; (2) containsThrow recurses into nested function bodies, so a catch block outside approved adapters that declares a nested function containing a throw, then returns err(...), counts as rethrowing even though the caught bug is swallowed. Fix: flag Result-bound variable declarations whose symbol has no other references (skipping exported bindings and shorthand-property usages), unwrap void/paren/await discards, and stop containsThrow at function/class boundaries so only throws on the actual catch path count. Add red coverage for both repros. Ranked a6B so the fix lands before li-2o7eza (GitHub App / 1Password wrapper) and li-m2trzv (coverage/property), per the watcher instruction.
title: Result/ROP gate is bypassable: unused-variable Result discard and nested-function rethrow

description: BLOCKING watcher review of 15d9b21 (li-m2trzv) found a bypass of NFR §"Test coverage expectations" in scripts/check-coverage.ts: when first-party src/** product source exists but no coverage report (or a report with zero matching src entries) proves 100% line/branch coverage, the gate returned 'armed' and exit 0 — so once the product-source boundary is relaxed, test:coverage could pass while measuring nothing.
